name: Nashville
tagline: Music City, No State Income Tax, and Southern Hospitality
description: Nashville combines zero state income tax with a booming cultural scene, world-class healthcare, and genuine Southern hospitality. The city's music heritage extends far beyond country — it is a hub for rock, indie, and Americana. Nashville's food scene has exploded in recent years, and the cost of living, while rising, remains well below coastal cities. Excellent hospitals like Vanderbilt make it particularly attractive for retirees who value medical access.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe in most neighborhoods with typical urban caution
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot summers and mild to cool winters

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable 1BR in Madison, Antioch, or Donelson, outside the trendy core

dining.description: Hot-chicken joints and casual BBQ a few times a week; mostly cooking at home

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan on Tennessee's ACA marketplace, assuming annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600 for a single person; above that, the full price climbs toward $1,000 a month. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance and gas; Nashville requires a car despite WeGo transit

entertainment.description: Free live music on Lower Broadway, Centennial Park, Shelby Bottoms greenways

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable one-bedroom in Madison, Antioch, or Donelson, cooking most meals at home with hot-chicken joints and casual BBQ a few times a week. A car is required despite WeGo transit, and the ACA Silver premium stays affordable only if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff. Free live music on Lower Broadway and the city's parks and greenways provide constant no-cost entertainment, and Tennessee's zero income tax stretches every withdrawal — though Nashville's boomtown rents make this the tighter end of the region.

10M.lifestyle: An estate in Belle Meade or a historic Oak Hill mansion, housekeeping a few days a week with a grounds service, and a private chef several days a week, with top-tier concierge care at Vanderbilt. First-class travel, a premium vehicle with car service, and club-level season tickets at Bridgestone Arena for concerts and Predators games all fit comfortably. Nashville's zero income tax on roughly $222k a year of spending means daily costs never register, funding an uncapped life with music-industry philanthropy and international travel.
